title: Book Two · Chapter 176: Thursday Elsewhere
story:
On Thursday, Ronan goes to his ordinary classroom after lessons. The final tasks are starting in the reading room. He can see the three candidates cross the yard from his window.

Leo carries no sample page. Mei has a pencil and a small ruler. The other girl walks beside Miss Wu with both hands around her bag strap.

Ronan turns away before they reach the door.

He has number work to finish. Two other students are using the classroom too. One asks him to close the window because the wind lifts her paper.

He closes it. The room grows quiet.

For the first ten minutes, he does almost nothing. He writes the date, rubs it out, and writes it again. He thinks about the final task. Perhaps there is a changed time. Perhaps the visitor needs a different entrance.

He could do those things now. Perhaps.

The girl beside him drops her pencil. It rolls under his chair. He picks it up and gives it back.

“Thank you,” she says. “Do you know this number question?”

Ronan looks at her page. He does not know it yet. He reads the instructions with her, and they work out the first step. After that, she can finish alone.

He returns to his own page. He finishes one question, then another. He can think about these questions for a while.

At the end of the hour, he packs his bag. Across the yard, the reading room door opens. The candidates come out separately. They all look tired. None of them knows the results yet.

Leo sees him and lifts a hand. Ronan waits by the gate.

“How was it?” he asks.

“Harder than the samples,” Leo says. “I needed to explain a change to a younger student.”

“Did you get it?”

“I think so. The results come next week.”

Ronan nods. He wants every detail. He also wants Leo to stop talking.

“Can we talk about something else?” he asks.

Leo looks at him, then agrees. “My aunt sent a picture of a very small bedroom.”

“Yours?”

“Perhaps. There is room for me or my bag. I may need to choose.”

Ronan laughs once. “Send the bag to school. Stay in bed.”

“A fine education.”

They walk toward River Street. Near the narrow lane, Ronan tells Leo about the number question. Leo gives a different first step. They talk about the two ways until they reach the food stall.

They stop there to draw the numbers on a scrap of paper. For a few minutes, they both think only about the numbers.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

candidate＝候选人；strap＝背带；separately＝分别地；work out＝想出、算出。

## 理解问题

1. 原最终选拔举行时，Ronan在哪里，做了什么？
2. 他怎样告诉Leo自己暂时需要换话题？

## 读句子

**He closes it.**

拆开看：He / closes / it.

他／关上／它。
